Cylindrical tanks, including oval, elongated oval, or round tanks, exceeding 330 gallons (1249.2 L) shall comply with the requirements of Section 1305.14.2.1 through 1305.14.2.3.
   Exception: Such above-ground vertical tanks that are outside of buildings shall comply with Section 1305.14.1 and 1305.14.5.
